headline: US sanctions Iran’s remaining aviation sector to isolate Tehran - OrissaPOST
summary: The Trump administration imposed sanctions on additional parts of Iran's aviation industry, targeting more than two dozen commercial and private airlines and foreign cargo providers. The measures are part of its Operation Economic Outcast campaign.
why: US sanctions restrict access to American markets and the dollar system, affecting airlines and logistics firms that trade with sanctioned entities.
